messages:
maya: Quick sync: finalizing UX decisions for routing policies editor v-next. Top items: reorder undo, preview placement (inline vs split), validation microcopy, and a11y confirmations.

chris: FYI i mocked two variants: inline playback under rules, and a split-pane preview at right. Inline keeps context; split-pane gives more room for matched-field details.

sam: i prefer inline for quick iteration. split-pane feels heavy for normal edits but could be an opt-in inspector. maybe default inline + 'Open inspector' to toggle split.

akiko: accessibility: if we open the split inspector it must trap focus and return focus on close. also keyboard shortcut to toggle inspector (Ctrl+I) would help power users.

leo: reorder undo: propose ephemeral snackbar 'Rule moved c Undo' visible 6s. pressing Undo returns previous order and focuses the moved rule with announcement 'Rule restored to position X'. aria-live required.

bryan: telemetry note: include event reorder.start, reorder.commit, reorder.undo with previous_index/next_index and policy_id. Keep tech codes out of UI copy.

chris: validation copy iteration: current 'Invalid' is too vague. variants: 1) concise: 'Needs condition'; 2) actionable: 'Rule inactive  add a match condition to enable'; 3) diagnostic: 'missing_match_condition (code: missing_match)'. UI shows variant 2, diagnostics only in logs.

akiko: confirm for screen readers the actionable bubble includes a link 'How to write conditions' with aria-label 'Open docs about routing conditions'. Ensure link receives clear focus.

sam: preview UX detail: when stepping rules show matched fields panel collapsed by default. pressing Enter expands details. add small latency metric next to each tick (e.g., 8ms) for debug.

chris: for match highlight, don't rely on green alone. use bolt icon + dashed underline + left border. also add a pattern overlay for colorblind users.

maya: mobile fallback: drag handles hidden on touch. show a three-dot menu with Move up / Move down / Pin to top / Edit. Pin limited to one rule per policy. show tooltip 'Pinned rules stay at top during simulation'.

leo: keyboard reordering: space to grab, arrows to move, space to drop, plus Move to Top/Bottom quick actions. announce 'Rule grabbed' and 'Moved to position N' via aria-live.

bryan: infra-bot: Reminder: canary tests for Dedicated should surface rule evaluation time in sim. we'll wire that metric into the preview if available.

maya: decision list for tomorrow's review: 1) default inline playback + optional inspector; 2) 6s undo snackbar with focus+announce on undo; 3) actionable validation copy + docs link; 4) non-color matched indicators + latency ticks; 5) mobile three-dot menu and single-pin rule; 6) telemetry events for reorder/undo. Anyone object?

sam: no objections. i'll scope spike for the undo + inspector toggle (2d).

chris: i'll update Figma with both inline and inspector variants and add microcopy options. will post link before the meeting.

akiko: i'll draft the a11y acceptance checklist (live regions, focus management, link labels).

infra-bot: Note: design-review scheduled 2026-05-20 15:00 UTC. Figma link expected 2026-05-20 13:30 UTC.

maya: great. please post Figma + acceptance criteria in this thread. thanks!
